item.title: The Best Beach Reads For Your Summer 2025 Reading List From Read With Jenna's Book Club
item.description: "Today" host Jenna Bush Hager has her best picks for your summer reading list. Here's what you should pick up on your next trip to the bookstore or library.

item.title: The Outdated Trend Sarah Huckabee Sanders Was Caught Wearing
item.description: Sarah Huckabee Sanders has never exactly been a fashion icon, but there's one passé trend she's trying to bring back -- and it's just not working.

item.title: Vanessa Trump Is Still Stunning Makeup Free
item.description: Given that Vanessa Trump is a former model, it shouldn't surprise anyone that she looks good without makeup. We've got the pics to prove it.

item.title: Throwback Snaps Of Melania Trump Remind Us What A Supermodel Stunner She's Always Been
item.description: Melania Trump caught President Donald Trump's attention, and her supermodel good looks likely had something to do with that. She's remained attractive, too.

item.title: Lacey Chabert's Worst-Dressed Moments Prove Even Hallmark Queens Can Fumble A Look
item.description: Actress Lacey Chabert rose to fame as Gretchen Wieners in 2004's "Mean Girls," and she's had some fashion fumbles over the years. Some worse than others.

item.title: Jennifer Love Hewitt Looks Ageless Going Make Up Free
item.description: Jennifer Love Hewitt proved that you can be gorgeous at any age with a makeup-free photo celebrating her 46th birthday, which suggested she's ageing in reverse.

item.title: Quinta Brunson's Most Stunning Red Carpet Looks
item.description: Quinta Brunson routinely stuns with her outfits on every red carpet she turns up to, but these looks are, by far, her absolutely most stunning of all.

item.title: The Most Heartbreaking Reads From Reese's Book Club
item.description: Reese Witherspoon has made plenty of sunny and optimistic picks for her book club, but the actress isn't afraid to pick a book that hits hard, either.

item.title: Melania Trump's Biggest Fashion Fails All Have One Big Thing In Common
item.description: Melania Trump has rocked some stylish looks, but one particular item of clothing seems to be her kryptonite, resulting in several fashion fails.

item.title: Ainsley Norris From Landman Couldn't Be More Stunning In Real Life
item.description: Similar to her Landman character Ainsley Norris, actor Michelle Randolph prefers to keep her makeup and fashion more laid back.
